title: My Friend Tom
text:
Tom is my friend. He is tall and has short brown hair. He has blue eyes and a big smile.

Tom likes music. He plays the guitar every evening. His dog is small and white. The dog's name is Max.

questions.text: What is the name of Tom's dog?
What kind of person is Tom most likely to be?
What can you guess about Tom's evenings?

paragraph_translations: Tom jest moim przyjacielem. Jest wysoki i ma krótkie brązowe włosy. Ma niebieskie oczy i szeroki uśmiech.
Tom lubi muzykę. Gra na gitarze każdego wieczoru. Jego pies jest mały i biały. Pies ma na imię Max.
